description.zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致。
description.en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. This value must be the same as the **IsolationId** specified when you called the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation to add users.

description.zh: 用户ID列表。请传入在调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户后，获取并保存到本地的用户ID。
description.en: The list of user IDs. Specify the user IDs that were obtained and saved locally after users were added by calling the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

- 单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。

    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

- The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for this operation is 100.

    > RAM users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
